title: MULTIPLANAR - Interactive Real-Time Multiplayer-Prompted Fantasy Heroes Adventure (Trailer + Gameplay)
author: Bookoora
selftext:
Three heroes. One dungeon. Your commands and votes shape what happens next—brought to life in generated video.  
  
Every hero sequence is in 5-second blocks. Decide whether to use their Might, Mind or Range to execute your command actions. Earn Resonance bonus with every successful hero action.  
  
Private DM-led adventures with party-led players in the works if main questline succeeds.  
  
Join the adventure: [https://games.bookoora.com/multiplanar/](https://www.youtube.com/redirect?event=video_description&redir_token=QUZZTVljSFBYanVIZTU5SFNrQ2dMWC00aE94Z3xBTl9pYzRla2tPVnlfNlpOeVBiZFhlcXM5T1J0aGpnSFVRSW1INGFNNmpVZkRHVnp6blU3b0dxcVIwbFNmZ1hNWkcxc053dkVsbVAwdlk4U3kxM08yQW1xbHk4QXlYaHhlYmZE&q=https%3A%2F%2Fgames.bookoora.com%2Fmultiplanar%2F&v=aT3luR2dzSE)
